bullets.text: Vision Restored with Implants - Patients regain central vision using **smart glasses** linked to an eye implant.
AI Tool for Doctors - **OpenEvidence** raises $200M, valued at $6B, for its medical AI platform.
Streaming Premier League Matches - Watch **West Ham vs. Brentford** live from anywhere, including the UK.
Oura's New Stress Feature - **Oura** launches an app update with a 'Cumulative Stress' feature for better health insights.
Apple Watch Ultra 3 Review - The **Apple Watch Ultra 3** impresses with its battery life and Modular Ultra watch face.
AirPods Live Translation Update - **iOS 26.1** expands AirPods Pro's Live Translation feature to five new languages.
Logitech's MX Master 4 - The **MX Master 4** mouse enhances productivity with haptics and a new action wheel.
Nexos.ai's Funding Success - **Nexos.ai** raises €30M to facilitate secure enterprise AI adoption amidst data concerns.
Periodic Labs' $300M Seed Round - **Periodic Labs** secures $300M to revolutionize AI in material science.
Waymo Under Investigation - **Waymo** faces scrutiny after a robotaxi drove around a stopped school bus.
